cohort: 4591 primiparous women delivering a singleton at a large hospital in Northern England between March 2007 and December 2010, including 640 adolescents (≤19 years) and 3951 women aged 20-34 years
finding: Compared to women aged 20-34 years, adolescents had significantly higher odds of extremely low birth weight and preterm delivery, but lower odds of gestational diabetes, cesarean delivery, and instrumental delivery.
mod_finding: Adolescents had lower odds of cesarean delivery compared to the reference group (aOR 0.53, 95% CI 0.42 to 0.67).
